stages.query:
Find the main general passenger phone for this exact airport.
IATA: CDG
Official English name: CDG
Google Maps local name: Aéroport de Paris-Charles de Gaulle
Country or region: France
Verified official airport/operator domains: paris-airport-cdg.com, parisaeroport.fr
Terminal context only (never choose an airline, shop, or terminal tenant): none

Actively search the airport or responsible operator's official website and read its original-language pages, not English pages only. Understand the local-language meaning of airport information, passenger enquiries, customer service, contact centre, or airport switchboard, and choose the one main number an ordinary passenger should call.
Do not collect all numbers from a page. Never return a copyright year, date, opening hours, postal code, registration number, airline, lost property, parking, cargo, hotel, police, medical, immigration, VIP, lounge, baggage, or other specialist department phone. Keep the official display format and do not invent a country code.
Return exactly one main number and these fixed fields, one per line:
AIRPORT_CONFIRMED:
GENERAL_PASSENGER_PHONE:
PHONE_ROLE:
OFFICIAL_CONTACT_URL:
SOURCE_LANGUAGE:
LOCAL_CONTACT_SEARCH_QUERY:
Write MISSING when GENERAL_PASSENGER_PHONE is unavailable. PHONE_ROLE must be a very short English description of the general passenger role. LOCAL_CONTACT_SEARCH_QUERY must be a short query in the official website's local language. GENERAL_PASSENGER_PHONE, PHONE_ROLE, and OFFICIAL_CONTACT_URL must each carry the same direct official airport/operator source citation.
